lines.text: The LORD tells Jeremiah to stand in the gate of the LORD's house and proclaim His message to Judah.
God says if they correct their ways, He will let them live there, so they must not trust the words about the temple.
God asks if they will steal, murder, and burn incense to Molech, then stand in His house and say they are delivered.
God calls His house a den of robbers and tells them to go see what He did to Bethel.
God says He will do to the house what He did to Shiloh and cast them out of His presence.
